title: Specialty Tier Cost Share Under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan
content:
Formulary tier 4 is preferred specialty and tier 5 is non-preferred specialty. Under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan each design gives each specialty tier a basis of copay or coinsurance. A specialty copay is a flat amount per 30-day supply. A specialty coinsurance is a fraction of the allowed amount, held between a per-fill minimum and a per-fill maximum where the design sets them; a minimum of 0.00 means no minimum and a maximum of 0.00 means no per-fill maximum.

## Tier 4 — preferred specialty

| Plan design | Basis | Copay per 30-day supply (USD) | Coinsurance rate | Per-fill minimum (USD) | Per-fill maximum (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | Coinsurance | 0.00 | 25% | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | Coinsurance | 0.00 | 30% | 150.00 | 400.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Value | Coinsurance | 0.00 | 25% | 125.00 | 350.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Select | Coinsurance | 0.00 | 20% | 100.00 | 300.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | Copay | 150.00 | 0% | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | Copay | 100.00 | 0% | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Tier 5 — non-preferred specialty

| Plan design | Basis | Copay per 30-day supply (USD) | Coinsurance rate | Per-fill minimum (USD) | Per-fill maximum (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | Coinsurance | 0.00 | 40% | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | Coinsurance | 0.00 | 50% | 250.00 | 600.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Value | Coinsurance | 0.00 | 40% | 200.00 | 500.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Select | Coinsurance | 0.00 | 30% | 150.00 | 450.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | Copay | 250.00 | 0% | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | Copay | 200.00 | 0% | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Where the per-fill limits bite (hypothetical allowed amounts)

The rows below apply the Northbridge Rx Select tier 4 figures — 20%, a minimum of 100.00 and a maximum of 300.00 — to hypothetical allowed amounts, to show both sides of each limit:

| Hypothetical allowed amount (USD) | 20% of it (USD) | Tier cost share (USD) | Which figure governs |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400.00 | 80.00 | 100.00 | The per-fill minimum |
| 500.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 | Rate and minimum coincide |
| 1000.00 | 200.00 | 200.00 | The rate |
| 1500.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | Rate and maximum coincide |
| 2000.00 | 400.00 | 300.00 | The per-fill maximum |

Under Northbridge Rx HSA Saver neither limit exists, so a hypothetical 2000.00 allowed amount on tier 4 gives a tier cost share of 25% of it, 500.00, with no cap.
